title: eng hiring onboarding interview debriefs weekly sync 2026-03-04
content:
Weekly hiring + onboarding sync notes (standup style) - 2026-03-04

Attendees: Maya Li (owner), Rafael Torres, Priya Nair, Evan McDowell, + casual drop-ins from SRE and DevRel.

Summary / purpose:
- Weekly sync focused on live interview debriefs, outstanding offers, ramp status for new hires, and team health flags.
- Goal: make hiring decisions visible, unblock onboarding infra issues, and track mentoring capacity.

1) Interview debriefs (panel notes & recommendations)
- Candidate: "Data Eng Lead - A. Patel" (onsite 2026-03-02)
  - Interviewers: Priya, Evan, SRE rep
  - Strengths: clear system design, good tradeoffs for high-throughput ingestion, experienced with streaming architectures.
  - Concerns: limited experience with GPU infra and inference pipelines.
  - Panel score: 7/10 overall
  - Recommendation: move to hiring committee for final calibration; consider pairing with infra lead role to bridge gaps.
  - Next step: Priya to flag top-3 compensation range by 2026-03-06.

- Candidate: "SWE II - Sophie Kim" (offer accepted; start 2026-02-23)
  - Note: We already onboarded Sophie; this entry documents interview notes for records.
  - Interview summary: strong backend fundamentals, good debugging, collaborative.
  - Recommendation: standard SWE II leveling.

- Candidate: "Infra SWE - J. Morales" (remote, final loop 2026-03-05)
  - Panel: Rafael, infra lead, release engineer
  - Strengths: deep infra automation, rollout/CI expertise, terraform heavy.
  - Concerns: cultural fit flagged by one interviewer (prefers solo contributor style).
  - Recommendation: hold final debrief after 3/5 loop; Rafael to collect written feedback by EOD 3/5.

- Candidate: "ML Infra Internship - multiple" (campus referrals)
  - Notes: still in early screen. Volume is higher than expected; need to define rubric for intern projects (quant + infra). Priya to draft rubric by 3/10.

2) Offers / pipeline status
- Pending offers: 2 senior roles (Data Eng Lead, Infra SWE). Compensation calibrations in progress; target to close by 3/12.
- Offers extended: 1 (SWE II Sophie) - accepted and onboarding in progress.
- Pipeline health: 18 active candidates across roles; time-to-offer average ~26 days (improving).

3) Onboarding updates / ramp notes
- Sophie Kim (SWE II) - week 2 update:
  - Completed: access to GitHub, Okta, Slack, Confluence; completed runtime walkthrough and local dev setup.
  - In progress: private deployment lab (VPN + KMS test) - blocked by KMS key approval.
  - Mentor pairing: Rafael assigned as primary mentor; 2x 30m syncs/week scheduled.
  - Ramp tasks for next week: bugfix + small infra task (issue #341) and write a doc on local KVS caching behavior.

- New hire checklist / recurring onboarding issues:
  - Recurring blocker: KMS/HSM access approval takes 4-7 business days; coordinate with security early.
  - GH org invite delays: observed occasionally for contractors; platform team to add a faster invite flow for contractors.
  - VPN onboarding steps: update the step-by-step in Confluence (Priya to update by 3/09).

4) Mentorship capacity + team health
- Mentor load: Rafael now mentoring Sophie + one SWE intern (capacity near limit). Need to avoid overloading senior ICs during hiring ramp.
- Suggestion: formalize "mentorship hours" policy (2-4 hours/week suggested) so capacity shows up in planning. Action: Maya to draft policy proposal by 3/18.
- Team stress signals: several folks reported higher context-switching due to on-call + interview loops. Recommend micro-rotations for interviews to reduce burnout.

5) Action items (owners & due dates)
- Priya: compensation ranges for Data Eng Lead by 2026-03-06.
- Rafael: collect final written feedback for J. Morales loop by 2026-03-05.
- Priya: draft intern project rubric by 2026-03-10.
- Platform/Infra: expedite GitHub invite flow for contractors; RFC in progress (assigned to Evan) - target 2026-03-15.
- Security: KMS approval SLA - request to reduce manual steps; Maya to follow up with Security on 2026-03-06.
- Maya: draft mentorship hours policy for eng hiring plan by 2026-03-18.
- Priya: update VPN onboarding doc on Confluence by 2026-03-09.

6) Open questions / blockers (for execs or cross-functional)
- Can Finance pre-approve a wider compensation band for critical infra hires to accelerate offers? (ask Finance leads)
- Can Security provide a documented SLA for KMS key approvals? This is repeatedly slowing onboarding.
- Headcount: confirm Q2 hiring freeze risk (rumors) — need clarity by 3/12 so active offers can be processed.

7) Quick metrics snapshot
- Active reqs: 8 (3 senior, 3 mid, 2 intern)
- Time-to-offer (rolling 30d): 26 days
- Offers accepted / extended (30d): 3 / 5
- New hires started (last 30d): 2

8) Retro notes from last week (what changed)
- Interview rubric tweaks reduced variance in hiring committee feedback.
- Onboarding checklist additions helped Sophie onboard faster for the first-week dev environment.
- Still need to resolve KMS approval delays.

Misc notes / links:
- Candidate feedback templates in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Interview+Templates
- Hiring committee calendar: slack pinned #hiring-committee and calendar invites

Informal notes / reminders to self:
- Keep rotating interviewers so the same seniors aren't overloaded.
- Consider hiring a specialized onboarding coordinator (temp) if ramp hits +5 hires in a quarter.
- Track mentor hours in quarterly OKRs if we formalize the mentorship policy.

Next sync: weekly cadence, 2026-03-11, 10:00-10:30 PT.

End of notes.
